description: As a geotechnical engineer evaluating terrain for a proposed infrastructure corridor, analyze the SRTM digital elevation model in SNAP Desktop to assess construction suitability. The DEM file (srtm_dem.tif) is loaded in the Product Explorer. Produce a terrain analysis that includes a measure of terrain steepness derived from the elevation data, and a classification layer that categorizes the landscape into zones of differing construction difficulty. Save your complete analysis product in BEAM-DIMAP format and export the terrain assessment as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.
